features.name: Legal Cost Calculator
features.description: Core calculator: category + state + complexity -> cost range
features.evidence: API returns correct data for CA divorce moderate ($5,900-$10,600-$17,700). All 8 categories, 51 states, 3 complexity levels functional.
acceptance: User selects legal category from 8 options
Disclaimer visible above and below results

features.name: Programmatic SEO Landing Pages
features.description: 416 statically generated pages (51 states x 8 categories + base pages)
features.evidence: npm run build generates 416 pages. /california/divorce-cost renders correctly with H1, FAQ schema, internal links.
acceptance: Each page has unique H1, title, meta description
Internal links to same-category other states
Internal links to same-state other categories

features.name: Cost Comparison
features.description: Side-by-side comparison of costs between states
features.evidence: API /api/costs/compare?states=CA,TX&category=divorce returns 2 states with all complexity levels. Compare page renders.

features.name: Disclaimer System
features.description: Legal disclaimer on every page, UPL risk mitigation
features.evidence: Disclaimer component used in Home, SEO Landing, Compare pages. Both top and bottom placement. No advice-type features.
acceptance: Disclaimer at top of every page
Disclaimer at bottom of every page
Consistent disclaimer text across all pages
